Immediately after it, the supplied 32:2 text moves through the HFT-traced descent word at position 1 and book/writing word at position 2. Their attributed delivery and letter-ordering roles meet the opening through adjacency, shifting it from an opaque preface outside the following statement to a possible first material contact with the book's delivery and construction.
